name: create-plan
title_zh: 开工前先落一份编号实施计划到 .plans/
tagline_zh: 你说「规划一下」它不空谈，直接产出可勾选的编号步骤文件。适合多步改造、重构、上线前拆活，让每件事都有处可查。
tagline_en: When you ask to plan or outline, it writes a numbered, checkable step file into .plans/ — no vague talk, just a.
desc_en: Create a numbered implementation plan in `.plans/` when the user asks to plan, outline, or sequence work.
why_zh: 把「想清楚」变成「写下来」：计划落在仓库里，可版本管理、可逐条勾选，后续执行不靠脑子记。
why_en: It turns 'thinking it through' into a committed, versionable file — check off steps as you go, no relying on memory.
limit_zh: 只在用户明确要求 plan/outline/sequence 时触发；不自动规划，不生成任务清单以外的内容。
limit_en: Triggers only on explicit plan/outline/sequence requests; outputs a Markdown file in .plans/ only — no scheduling, no dependency analysis, no.
title_en: Drop a numbered implementation plan into .plans/ before.
